name_input: R.E. ROGERS INDIA PVT LTD; R E ROGERS INDIA PVT LTD; R.E.ROGERS INDIA PVT. LTD.; R E ROGERS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No outbound (export) shipment row was found in any accessible source. ImportKey India customs view for slug 'r-e-rogers-india-private-limited' shows 17 records, all in the BUYER column, e.g. "2025-11-12 | HYVE SOLUTIONS EUROPE LIMITED | R.E. ROGERS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | ... NETWORK SWITCH(FOR SERVER) | CAIBARIEN, UNITED KINGDOM | SAHAR AIR, India | 85176290 | BOL 1652565" — i.e. goods entering India, not leaving it. Source counter: page states "Total Shipments 17 Records detected"; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 (2025-11-12, 2025-11-07, 2025-10-15, 2025-03-22, 2025-02-15). A second slug ('r-e-rogers-india-pvt-ltd') returned 5 US-side rows, again all as consignee: "2022-03-16 | EXPOTECHNIK ASIA PTE LTD | R.E.ROGERS INDIA PVT. LTD. ... EXHIBITION MATERIAL | Singapore, Singapore | INNAH, India | 902301.0 | SIN3HH0HC300W". Third slug ('r-e-rogers-india-pvt-ltd-1') returned an empty record set. No export B/L with an Indian-origin lane and a foreign destination was seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report India-sales split could be retrieved: bidassist search returned an empty page, and thecompanycheck/zaubacorp returned HTTP 403. Nothing to quote, so domestic supply is recorded as unknown rather than declared.
note: Role is importer/distributor, not exporter: every customs row found is inbound (UK, Singapore, Russia, and a US-side consignee record), and the cargo is consistent with trade-fair/exhibition support and IT hardware — "EXHIBITION MATERIAL" (HS 902301), "LEAFLETS (EDUCATION LITERATURE AND DISPLAY MATERIAL IS FOR FREE DISTRIBUTION)" (49111090), "BOOKS (FOR PROMOTION PURPOSE NOT FOR SALE ON FOC BASIS)" (49011010), "NETWORK SWITCH(FOR SERVER)" (85176290). Declared HS 847150 (ADP machines/processing units) does not match any observed line; per project rule this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the factual code should be corrected to the observed mix (85176290 hardware; 4901/4911 promotional print). Two different addresses appear across records (Sarita Vihar, New Delhi vs. JNPA-SEZ warehouse, Navi Mumbai, Raigad), so the entity may have relocated or the records may conflate related registrations — worth confirming the current registered address. No export shipments and no domestic supply evidence found; per Rule 5 this is stated plainly: следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено, внутренние поставки не подтверждены. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). PAN AAACR0251M and CIN were not verifiable here (registry lookups blocked) and are not asserted.
